# TestScript for 28-explicit-config-file
# Asserts conga.ConfigExplicit(...) semantics: bootstrap.yaml is the programmatic
# target (fatal if missing), only --config-file outranks it, and the
# EXPLICIT_CONFIG environment variable is ignored while the option is declared.

# 1. The programmatic explicit file loads without any flag
exec explicit-config
stdout '⚙  explicit-config'
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+bootstrap\.yaml\s+● cli bootstrap\.yaml'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+explicit\.example\.com\s+● config host'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9100\s+● config port'

# 2. EXPLICIT_CONFIG is not consulted: the explicit option still wins
env EXPLICIT_CONFIG=env.yaml
exec explicit-config
stdout '--host\s+string\s+explicit\.example\.com\s+● config host'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9100\s+● config port'
env EXPLICIT_CONFIG=

# 3. The --config-file flag outranks the explicit option
exec explicit-config -c override.yaml
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+override\.yaml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+override\.example\.com\s+● config host'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9200\s+● config port'

# 4. Missing explicit file is fatal: exit 1, not a usage error
rm bootstrap.yaml
exit-status 1 explicit-config
stderr 'cannot read config file "bootstrap\.yaml"'

-- bootstrap.yaml --
host: explicit.example.com
port: 9100

-- override.yaml --
host: override.example.com
port: 9200

-- env.yaml --
host: env.example.com
port: 9300
